Hey everyone! Hope you’re having a great evening! 😊
I was hoping someone could point me in the right direction. My boyfriend is German and has a valid work permit in Jerusalem, and I’m Mexican. Does anyone know what the process is for him to invite or sponsor me so I can legally live and work in Israel?

I would really appreciate any guidance or if you could share your experience. Thank you so much, and have a wonderful day! 🙏🏼
